description: Defines interfaces and classes for CU-UP processor, including E1AP communication, management notifications, and UE handling within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: cu_up_processor_e1ap_interface
classes.description: Interface for E1AP notifier to communicate with CU-UP processor, providing methods for task control, message handling, and interface access.

classes.name: cu_up_processor_cu_up_management_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying CU-CP about CU-UP connection events and removal requests.

classes.name: cu_up_ue_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling UE index updates.

classes.name: cu_up_processor
classes.description: Main interface combining E1AP communication and UE handling for CU-UP processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancel pending tasks for a given UE.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_request
methods.description: Handle GNB-CU-UP E1 Setup Request message.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Initiate E1 Reset procedure as per TS 38.483.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_manager
methods.description: Get E1AP bearer context manager interface.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_removal_handler
methods.description: Get E1AP bearer context removal handler interface.
